name: aso-service
description: ASO analytics service for Apple App Store (FoxData-like)

scripts.build: tsc && cp src/db/schema.sql dist/db/schema.sql && mkdir -p dist/scrapers/finsky/proto dist/scrapers/finsky/devices && cp src/scrapers/finsky/proto/*.proto dist/scrapers/finsky/proto/ && cp src/scrapers/finsky/devices/*.properties dist/scrapers/finsky/devices/
scripts.start: node dist/db/migrate.js && node dist/api/server.js & node dist/jobs/scheduler.js
